title: Love Slides — Production deployment + post-deploy smoke test (frontend)

requirements.summary: Add frontend-side deployment guidance to publish the current build to a live Internet Computer deployment and capture the live URL.
acceptanceCriteria: A production/live deployment is created from the current codebase.
The platform returns a live URL (or equivalent identifier) for the production deployment.
Visiting the live URL loads the app successfully without runtime errors.

file_operations.description: Create a deployment runbook for making the app live on the Internet Computer, including build/export steps and where to retrieve/store the live URL. Use the selected github-export-icp-cli component as the reference for ICP CLI/Docker/dfx deployment workflow. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update metadata documentation comments (non-functional) to reference the production deployment runbook and the expected live URL location, without changing runtime behavior.

requirements.summary: Add a basic post-deployment smoke test checklist for validating key UI flows on the live deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: The carousel view loads and navigation (Next/Previous) works.
On the final slide, clicking "No" shows the rejection title "Nice Try! 😋".
Clicking "Yes! 💕" shows the transition overlay and then the accepted state, and the "Moments💞" button navigates to the Moments page.

file_operations.description: Create a manual smoke test checklist to be run against the production/live URL that verifies: carousel loads; Next/Previous works; final slide 'No' renders title 'Nice Try! 😋'; 'Yes! 💕' shows LoveTransitionOverlay then accepted state; 'Moments💞' navigates to the Moments view. Reference the existing App carousel/Moments flow and shadcn-ui Button interactions at a high level. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add minimal, non-visual testability hooks/documentation (e.g., stable data attributes and/or inline comments) to make the smoke test steps unambiguous without changing UI/UX or behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
